items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Yeah, I remember the one that was running out was Chris, not Chris. No, Sig Christian's his old lady.

ctx.x: I remember him saying that with Pinky when he would write a thing, don't worry if it's not going to be a hit. Because he says if it gets on the record and if the flip side is a hit, he says you got a hit too. So, I mean, he wrote a lot of things that he just wanted to get on record. And he had one of them on the one side of Andrew's sister's record that he did very well. I can't remember his name. He used to, he was a publisher from, he used to have a publishing company.

Yeah, I remember the one that was running out was Chris, not Chris. No, Sig Christian's his old lady. That's the one you're talking about. I can't remember his name. I can't remember his name. I can't remember his name.

What about this note about Columbia's tunes, Dick? I just wondered if they pushed any tunes. But you, we went over that, didn't we? Yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Crum knew all that. Yeah. We still didn't finish with what happened to the leaders of the band. You and, you and...
